name: LoanDesk demonstration business lending policy
disclaimer: Fictional policy for synthetic portfolio cases, not a real bank's credit rules.

clauses.text: A profit-and-loss statement and twelve months of bank transaction records are required.
The business must have operated for at least 24 months.
Annual revenue must be at least AED 250000.
Debt service coverage must be at least 1.25, including the proposed loan installment.
Reported revenue and twelve-month bank income differing by more than 5 percent require clarification.
A human loan officer must review and approve the exact assessment revision. This does not authorize loan disbursement.
